Leave room for a later evening

By v/hNovember 23, 2026Note

Originally shared
on LinkedIn

View the post ↗← All journal entries

A lamp should let you finish the chapter, even if it has learned your usual bedtime.

The lamp we're designing would learn locally from ordinary on/off use. A repeated switch-off time is useful context, but it cannot establish whether someone is still using the light.

The proposed behavior needs both a learned evening window and reliable evidence of sustained absence before an automatic fade. Uncertain presence should prevent automatic switch-off.

The same physical button should restore the light during a fade. Repeated corrections should make the assistance back off. There should be no schedule to edit or app to open because tonight is different.

No physical prototype has been built yet. Keeping the light on for a still reader is a requirement we need to validate, not a result we've established.

See the design and intended behavior: https://vh.do/lamp/
